en.headline: Hang Seng closes up 46 points as chip and AI shares advance
en.dek: The index ended at 24,713 after swinging lower earlier, with Lenovo rising more than 8 per cent and semiconductor names among the stronger performers.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed higher on Wednesday, with the Hang Seng Index finishing at 24,713, up 46 points or 0.19 per cent, after earlier dipping nearly 100 points.

Main-board turnover reached about HK$181 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.79 per cent. Chip and artificial-intelligence related shares led the gains, with Lenovo Group advancing more than 8 per cent, the strongest blue-chip performer of the session.

Semiconductor names including SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor also rose nearly 5 to 6 per cent. Gold-related stocks advanced, while CATL was among the weaker Hang Seng constituents, falling nearly 3 per cent. Trip.com recovered to close nearly 4 per cent higher after earlier weakness following its results.

zh.headline: 恒指收升46點 晶片及AI股造好
zh.dek: 恒生指數收報24,713點，升46點或0.19%，早段曾跌近100點後回升，聯想升逾8%，為當日表現最佳藍籌。
body: 港股周三收市上升，恒生指數收報24,713點，升46點或0.19%，早段曾跌近100點至24,574點後反覆回升，主板成交約1,811億元。
科技指數升約0.8%。晶片及人工智能相關股份表現強勁，聯想集團升逾8%，為恒指及科指成份股中升幅最大。中芯國際及華虹半導體亦升近5%至近6%。
黃金相關股份上升，紫金礦業及老鋪黃金分別升逾3%及逾5%。寧德時代跌近3%，為表現較弱的恒指成份股之一。攜程業績後早段偏軟，其後回升，收市升近4%。
